gen-gf-warnes-gf-anuphan: Stretched, spacious and wire-straight, Warnes draws its ink strokes to a taper before they ever touch. Anuphan, a plain sans with big round bowls, does the quiet work.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-arimo: Loud, stretched-out letters with constant strokes up top, then Arimo's tall, rounded sans forms underneath. One shouts, one explains.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-armata: Armata reads as sans-serif with wide gaps between characters and lowercase that fills most of its height. And Warnes, with its rounded-wire strokes, supplies the pair's boldest quality.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-athiti: Bold, stretched and cut like sign-shop vinyl. Athiti follows as a plain sans with a high mean line and a visible gap in every s, so body text on it stays friendly at modest sizes.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Atkinson Hyperlegible reads as sans-serif with clipped capitals and ascenders sitting beside wide-set terminals on the s. Atkinson Hyperlegible keeps long paragraphs approachable, while Warnes, with round bowls whose walls never swell, stays out front.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-m: Fat crossbars and stretched tracking give Warnes a loud, inky stance. And Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, a sans-serif with stencil-bridge spacing and open counters, does the careful reading work.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-n: Warnes has crossbars as thick as its stems, which gives every heading a heavy, stretched-out stance. And Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, a sans-serif with big open lowercase eyes, settles in beneath it.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-biryani: Bold, stretched and tapered, Warnes looks like ink strokes that stop just short of touching, with no thick-and-thin at all. Biryani, a plain sans with unclogged counters, keeps it grounded.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-blinker: Approachable is the first word for Blinker, a sans-serif whose lowercase fills the height. Blinker keeps its lines steady and its apertures open, so a long passage under Warnes goes down smoothly.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-carrois-gothic: Warnes has a pen-plotter smoothness, with ink strokes that taper out before touching and stretched, spacious tracking. Carrois Gothic, a plain sans with a high x-height and open c, does the quieter work of being read.
